Sandbox_AlphaGal_MildReactionChance_tool: Chance that a mild exposure actually causes symptoms.
Sandbox_AlphaGal_ModerateReactionChance_: Chance that a moderate exposure actually causes symptoms.
Sandbox_AlphaGal_SevereReactionChance_to: Chance that a severe exposure becomes life-threatening. The default is 100%, so a full red-meat serving is lethal.
Sandbox_AlphaGal_ReactionDelayHours_tool: In-game hours between eating a trigger food and symptoms beginning. Default: 2 hours.
Sandbox_AlphaGal_SevereReactionHours_too: In-game hours from the start of a severe reaction until breathing failure. Default: 3 hours.
Sandbox_AlphaGal_ExposureDecayPerHour_to: How quickly stored alpha-gal exposure fades between meals.
